Elias smiled, tucked the note in his coat, and turned back to tend the glowing beam cutting through the dusk.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还裹在一层薄纱似的雾里，沿街的路灯晕开暖黄的光圈，偶尔有早班环卫车缓缓驶过，扫帚划过地面的沙沙声轻得像呼吸。卷帘门半开的早点铺飘出第一笼包子的热气，几只野猫蹲在公交站台的檐下舔着爪子，没有匆匆的车流，没有喧哗的人声，只有天边一点点泛白的光，慢慢把楼宇的轮廓从暗里拉出来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you solve a small version of the same problem to answer a bigger one, like looking for your lost toy in a stack of boxes.\n- First, you always have a clear 'stop point' so you don’t keep going forever—for example, if the box is empty, you know the toy isn’t there.\n- If the box isn’t empty, you look inside it first, then repeat the same check on the next smaller box until you find what you’re looking for."}
